--- /dev/null
+++ b/toolz/tests/test_tlz_path_ownership.py
@@ -0,0 +1,85 @@
+import types
+
+import pytest
+import toolz
+import tlz._build_tlz as builder
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(params=['both', 'cytoolz', 'toolz'])
+def backends(request, monkeypatch):
+    fast = types.ModuleType('cytoolz.audit', 'fast documentation')
+    slow = types.ModuleType('toolz.audit', 'slow documentation')
+    for backend in (fast, slow):
+        backend.__package__ = backend.__name__
+        backend.__file__ = backend.__name__ + '.py'
+        backend.marker = object()
+    fast.pipe = object()
+    slow.pipe = toolz.pipe
+    available = {}
+    if request.param in ('both', 'cytoolz'):
+        available[fast.__name__] = fast
+    if request.param in ('both', 'toolz'):
+        available[slow.__name__] = slow
+
+    def fake_import(name):
+        if name in available:
+            return available[name]
+        raise ImportError(name)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(builder, 'import_module', fake_import)
+    selected = fast if fast.__name__ in available else slow
+    introspection = slow if slow.__name__ in available else fast
+    return builder.TlzLoader(), selected, introspection
+
+
+def execute(backends, target):
+    loader, selected, introspection = backends
+    loader.exec_module(target)
+    assert target.__name__ == 'tlz.audit'
+    assert target.__package__ == 'tlz.audit'
+    assert target.marker is selected.marker
+    assert target.__file__ == introspection.__file__
+    expected_pipe = toolz.pipe if introspection.pipe is toolz.pipe else selected.pipe
+    assert target.pipe is expected_pipe
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('locations', [[], ['first', 'second'], ('first', 'second')])
+def test_missing_target_path_gets_independent_list(backends, locations):
+    _, selected, _ = backends
+    selected.__path__ = locations.copy() if isinstance(locations, list) else locations
+    target = types.ModuleType('tlz.audit')
+    execute(backends, target)
+    assert target.__doc__ == selected.__doc__
+    assert isinstance(target.__path__, list)
+    assert target.__path__ == list(locations)
+    assert target.__path__ is not selected.__path__
+    target.__path__.append('target-only')
+    assert list(selected.__path__) == list(locations)
+    if isinstance(selected.__path__, list):
+        selected.__path__.append('backend-only')
+        assert 'backend-only' not in target.__path__
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('existing', [[], ['local'], ('local',), None])
+def test_existing_target_path_is_preserved(backends, existing):
+    _, selected, _ = backends
+    selected.__path__ = ['backend']
+    target = types.ModuleType('tlz.audit', 'target documentation')
+    target.__path__ = existing
+    target.marker = object()
+    retained = target.marker
+    loader, _, _ = backends
+    loader.exec_module(target)
+    assert target.__path__ is existing
+    assert target.marker is retained
+    assert target.__doc__ == 'target documentation'
+
+
+def test_no_selected_path_is_not_synthesized(backends):
+    _, selected, introspection = backends
+    if introspection is not selected:
+        introspection.__path__ = ['slow-only']
+    target = types.ModuleType('tlz.audit')
+    execute(backends, target)
+    assert not hasattr(target, '__path__')
+    assert not hasattr(selected, '__path__')

spec.question: Fix package-path ownership during `TlzLoader.exec_module` in `tlz/_build_tlz.py`. A target module constructed directly with `types.ModuleType` currently shares the backend's mutable search path after execution. When the target has no `__path__` and the selected backend has one, the target must receive a fresh list containing that backend's search locations, so later mutations cannot affect either module through the other. Any `__path__` already present on the target must survive by identity, including an empty list. If neither the target nor the selected backend has a path, leave the attribute absent; a path available only on the nonselected backend must not be used. Preserve backend selection, other namespace population, and existing introspection behavior. Return a unified diff changing production files only.
